title: Empty consistency-proof array

sentences.text: It MUST contain the `consistency-proof` (-2) key, whose value is an array of one or more `ccf-consistency-proof` values, each relating one older root to the newer root.

reading_b.rule_text: 4.1: "It MUST contain the consistency-proof (-2) key, whose value is an array of one or more ccf-consistency-proof values"

tree_sizes_note: older_size: the size of the ledger tree whose root older_root is; newer_size: the seqno of the receipt's ccf.v1 txid 2.24, the tree size its signature covers as measured on CCF 7.0.17 with leaf 0 counted (not stated by -05)

reading_b_with_sizes.rule_text: 4.1: "It MUST contain the consistency-proof (-2) key, whose value is an array of one or more ccf-consistency-proof values"

provenance.note: the service's own COSE_Sign1 over R_24 from the fixture, its unprotected header replaced; the proofs are computed from the ledger's leaves
